question: Which body points must the prescribed line touch in this measurement?
premises: A reference point is on the right side of the navel.
Another reference point is the right side of the left thigh.
The line should touch that point.
inference: The measurement line should pass from the navel’s right side to touch the right side of the left thigh.
plain_english: On the right side of the navel, the line should touch the right side of the left thigh.
